title: Quantum Entanglement Chain Mode
description: A game mode where players are tethered to 2-3 other random balls across the map with an unbreakable quantum chain. If one player in the chain picks up a specific type of booster (like speed or shield), the entire chain gets a fraction of that boost. However, if one player takes environmental damage, the chain distributes the damage equally among all members. The key strategy is trying to pull your teammates towards health and away from hazards, acting as an involuntary hive mind.
